"""Phone number formatting for the contact book."""


def format_phone(digits):
    """Formats a 10-digit string as '(AAA) BBB-CCCC'.

    Non-digit characters in the input are ignored before formatting.
    """
    cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in digits if ch.isdigit())
    if len(cleaned) != 10:
        raise ValueError("expected 10 digits, got %d" % len(cleaned))
    return "(%s) %s-%s" % (cleaned[0:3], cleaned[3:6], cleaned[6:10])

from src.phonefmt import format_phone


class TestPhonefmt(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_format_with_area_code(self):
        self.assertEqual(format_phone("5551234567"), "(555) 123-4567")

    def test_separators_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(format_phone("555 123 4567"), "(555) 123-4567")


if __name__ == "__main__":
